scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && dotenv -e .env --no-expand -- concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.check: npm run build -w shared && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=none shared/tests/*.test.ts server/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:database: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && node docker/with-test-database.mjs node --import tsx --test --test-isolation=none server/tests/api.integration.ts
